If I'm rejected from w, my last choice is y. My priority at y is 1, but it's also the most popular school, so I'm unlikely to get in.

Therefore, I should strategically rank w higher to increase my chances of getting *a* match. I'm willing to sacrifice my absolute top choice (z) to improve my chances of getting into a school where I have a high priority.
